verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents a REST API for managing accounts and pipelines programmatically, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions API versioning, version headers or paths, or a deprecation and sunset policy. The fact that a REST API exists does not show that it is versioned or governed by a published deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
